articles.description: While it was always expected that the host would dominate the proceedings this year, the huge gap on the turf raises questions about the relevance of the competition, especially for India

articles.headline: Riot police deploy outside Polish constitutional court amid leadership dispute
articles.title: Protests outside Poland’s constitutional court: What’s the crisis about?
articles.summary: Riot police secured the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw on Friday following a leadership dispute between Prime Minister Donald Tusk's administration and the nationalist opposition Law and Justice party. The confrontation escalated after judges suspended tribunal president Bogdan Swieczkowski, prompting President Karol Nawrocki to interrupt an official trip to Senegal and return to Poland for urgent consultations.
articles.description: Poland’s centrist government says it is restoring judicial independence after years of far-right political interference.

articles.headline: Thousands protest across Italy over living costs and military spending
articles.title: Thousands protest across Italy over living costs and military spending
articles.description: Thousands have protested across Italy against rising living costs and increased military spending.

articles.headline: Six-year-old girl critically injured in school assault by boy
articles.title: Six-year-old girl critically injured in alleged assault by boy at Chandigarh’s Panchkula school
articles.summary: According to police, an eight-year-old boy allegedly assaulted a six-year-old classmate inside a Panchkula classroom on October 28, 2026. The victim suffered critical injuries and was hospitalised at the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research in Chandigarh. Deputy Commissioner of Police Amrinder Singh stated that the suspect is undergoing a medical assessment to determine further legal action while authorities investigate school officials.
articles.description: The police said the eight-year-old boy is undergoing a medical assessment, while the girl remains under treatment at PGIMER, Chandigarh

articles.headline: Class 10 student seriously injured in classroom attack in Andhra Pradesh
articles.title: Class 10 student attacked with wood-cutting machine inside classroom in A.P.’s Anantapur; accused yet to be identified
articles.summary: A Class 10 student at Zilla Parishad High School in Raptadu was seriously injured after being attacked with a wood-cutting machine inside her classroom on October 31, 2026. The unidentified accused fled the scene leaving the weapon behind, while police and state leaders including Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed authorities to apprehend the perpetrator swiftly.
articles.description: The girl who was seriously injured in the attack is undergoing treatment in a hospital; two youths who allegedly carried out the attack were not students of the school, fellow students said

articles.headline: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan warns society against accepting unverified claims
articles.title: Society that accepts unverified claims and fears questions is vulnerable to authoritarianism: Justice Bhuyan
articles.summary: Supreme Court judge Justice Ujjal Bhuyan stated during an address at the University of Science and Technology, Meghalaya that uncritical acceptance of claims without evidence leaves society vulnerable to authoritarianism. Speaking on October 31, 2026, he emphasized that building a scientific temper and critical inquiry among students is essential to resist misinformation and societal division.
articles.description: Speaking at the University of Science and Technology, Meghalaya, the Supreme Court judge said building a scientific temper must extend beyond laboratories to the capacity of youths and students to think rationally, and urged a shift from ‘us’ and ‘they’ to the Preamble’s ‘we’

articles.headline: Kiren Rijiju challenges Congress over electoral defeats and election commission
articles.title: Union Minister Rijiju challenges Congress to answer ‘basic questions’ amid row over SIR, CEC
articles.summary: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju challenged the Congress party on October 31, 2026, to explain its past electoral defeats while defending the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. In a post on X, he questioned Congress criticisms of the Election Commission and accused the opposition of attempting to undermine the Constitution and Indian democracy.
articles.description: Referring to the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Mr. Rijiju questioned how the Congress suffered a third consecutive defeat when Gyanesh Kumar, the incumbent Chief Election Commissioner, was not heading the poll panel

articles.headline: Isro launches NVS-03 navigation satellite to restore Navic network
articles.title: ISRO NVS-03 launch: 5 things to know about India’s new navigation satellite
articles.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully launched the 2250 kg NVS-03 navigation satellite from Sriharikota on October 30, 2026, restoring the Navic system to its minimum operational configuration of four active spacecraft. The mission, featuring an indigenous atomic clock and L1 band integration, aims to provide positioning and timing services for civilian and defence applications across India and surrounding regions.
articles.description: ISRO successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota on October 30, 2026, restoring NavIC to a four-satellite, standalone operational status and advancing India’s push for an indigenous, more precise space-time network

articles.headline: Meitei groups hold rally in Imphal demanding chief minister resignation
articles.title: Meitei groups hold rally in Imphal; Manipur CM's resignation, abrogation of SoO truce pact sought
articles.summary: An umbrella body of Meitei groups organized a major rally in Imphal on October 31, 2026, demanding the Chief Minister's resignation and the abrogation of the Suspension of Operations agreement. COCOMI convenor Y. Dhiren criticized the government's failure to protect indigenous people amid ongoing ethnic violence that has severely affected Manipur since May 2023.
articles.description: The march came days after militants ambushed 14 Meitei men and killed three of them, sparking protests in the State

articles.headline: Texas border voters shift political allegiances amid economic and immigration pressures
articles.title: ‘Paycheck to paycheck’: Texas border voters shed parties amid economic woes
articles.summary: Voters in the Rio Grande Valley of Texas are increasingly moving away from traditional party loyalties due to economic hardships, rising freight costs, and immigration policies. Residents like Jesus Robles expressed regret over their 2024 votes as high poverty rates, inadequate infrastructure in colonias, and expensive housing continue to impact middle-class families across the region.
articles.description: Voters reassess 2024 swing towards Trump as Republicans and Democrats grapple for Rio Grande Valley votes.

articles.headline: CPCB directs Delhi-NCR authorities to close non-compliant industrial units
articles.title: CPCB threatens to shut NCR industries yet to order pollution-control devices
articles.summary: The Central Pollution Control Board directed pollution control authorities in Delhi-NCR to issue show-cause notices to industrial units failing to install air pollution control devices. Units have five days to provide evidence of equipment orders or face closure. The enforcement aims to curb winter pollution as authorities implement revised particulate matter emission norms across seventeen categories of highly polluting industries.
articles.description: In an October 30 letter, the Central Pollution Control Board asked authorities in Delhi, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan to issue show-cause notices to non-compliant units under the CAQM’s revised emission norms

articles.headline: Gujarat High Court division bench stays order lifting non-veg food ban
articles.title: Gujarat HC Judge strikes down ban on non-veg food sale in Somnath; two-Judge Bench stays her order
articles.summary: A two-judge division bench of the Gujarat High Court stayed a single-judge ruling that struck down a ban on selling non-vegetarian food near the Somnath temple. Chief Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak and Justice Nirzar Desai acted on an urgent appeal from the state government, keeping the collector notification active until a hearing on December 26, 2026.
articles.description: A division Bench stayed the judgment of Justice Nisha Thakore following an urgent appeal moved by the Gujarat Government, and directed that the Collector's notification banning the sale of non-veg food will continue for now

articles.headline: Granules India facility in Hyderabad receives eleven US FDA observations
articles.title: Finished dosage facility of Granules in Hyderabad gets 11 U.S. FDA observations
articles.summary: The United States Food and Drug Administration issued eleven observations following an inspection of Granules India Limited finished dosage facility in Gagillapur, Hyderabad. Conducted from October 19 to 30, 2026, the inspection resulted in no data integrity or cross-contamination findings. The company stated that manufacturing and distribution remain unaffected and a comprehensive response will be submitted within fifteen business days.
articles.description: The U.S. FDA issued a warning letter in February 2025 after inspecting the facility in August–September 2024

articles.headline: Lebanese military court charges thirteen individuals over confiscated Hezbollah explosives
articles.title: Lebanon charges 13 over confiscated Hezbollah explosives
articles.summary: A Lebanese military court charged thirteen people with weapons possession, undermining state security, and forming illegal associations following the seizure of a truck carrying 780 kilograms of explosives at the Dahr al-Baydar checkpoint. Two suspects were arrested while eleven remain at large. Hezbollah acknowledged owning the shipment for use against Israel, intensifying domestic debate over the armed group disarmament.
articles.description: Group calls charges 'unjust', says weapons were meant to be used against Israeli forces in south Lebanon.

articles.headline: Kerala struggles with tourism recovery while Sri Lanka surpasses pre-pandemic arrivals
articles.title: Why Sri Lanka’s tourism is thriving amid crises while Keralam struggles to regain lost ground despite its advantages
articles.summary: Foreign tourist arrivals in Kerala continue to stagnate at roughly seventy percent of pre-pandemic figures in 2026, whereas Sri Lanka has successfully surpassed its pre-COVID visitor numbers despite sharing comparable tropical appeal and adverse global conditions. Kerala holds distinct natural advantages, including scenic backwaters and authentic Ayurveda wellness tourism, but faces ongoing momentum challenges in regaining lost ground.
articles.description: The two destinations offer comparable tourism experiences and products. Even amid adverse global conditions, Colombo has managed to surpass its pre-COVID foreign tourist arrival figures, while Keralam has struggled to regain momentum, achieving only around 70% of its pre-pandemic arrivals

articles.headline: CCTV and zip ties: How US mail-in votes are secured and counted
articles.title: CCTV and zip ties: How US mail-in votes are secured and counted
articles.description: BBC Verify goes to an election centre to get a behind-the-scenes look at how mail-in ballots for the US midterm elections are processed.

articles.headline: Flávio Bolsonaro vows to continue father’s political fight in Brazil
articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vows to continue father’s political fight in Brazil
articles.description: Flávio Bolsonaro vows to continue father's political fight in Brazil

articles.headline: Telangana farmers shift toward horticulture crops to combat weather challenges
articles.title: Telangana farmers’ preference for veggies, spices over paddy continues in Yasangi 2026
articles.summary: Farmers in Telangana continue cultivating vegetables and spices instead of traditional paddy during the Yasangi season due to weather impacts. State Horticulture Director Shaik Yasmeen Basha reported increased sowing areas and noted that officials are providing drought-resistant seeds and irrigation resources. District officers stated that market demand and borewell irrigation heavily drive this ongoing agricultural transition across several districts.
articles.description: Excessive heat conditions in the next few months may bring down horticulture produce by around 20%, which may drive demand, says Telangana Horticulture Department’s Director Shaik Yasmeen Basha

articles.headline: Telangana plans public-private partnership model to improve hospital MRI services
articles.title: Telangana plans PPP model to ensure uninterrupted MRI services at govt hospitals
articles.summary: The Telangana government plans to adopt a Public-Private Partnership model to operate magnetic resonance imaging services across state hospitals, aiming to resolve technical disruptions. Health Minister C. Damodara Raja Narasimha announced that scans will remain free for referred patients, following a pilot project in Mahabubnagar. Officials estimate the arrangement will reduce government expenditure by approximately twenty percent compared to existing systems.
articles.description: Health Minister C. Damodara Raja Narasimha clarified that scans will remain free of cost for patients referred by doctors at Telangana government hospitals

articles.headline: Aam Aadmi Party releases first candidate list for Punjab Assembly elections
articles.title: AAP announces first list of 40 candidates for 2027 Punjab Assembly elections
articles.summary: The Aam Aadmi Party released its first list of forty candidates for the Punjab Assembly election scheduled early next year, fielding exclusively sitting legislators. Chief Minister Bhagwall Mann confirmed his candidacy from the Dhuri constituency in Sangrur district during a press briefing on October 31, 2026. The ruling party selected candidates based on public survey responses to campaign effectively ahead of the March 16 poll.
articles.description: Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will seek re-election from the Dhuri constituency in Sangrur district

articles.headline: One Planet Partners launches maiden fund to deploy over 3,000 crore rupees in India
articles.title: One Planet Partners to deploy over ₹3,000 crore in high-growth business in India
articles.summary: India-focused private equity firm One Planet Partners announced a partnership with Japan's Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank on October 29, 2026. The collaboration includes a maiden fund targeting over 3,000 crore rupees for mid-market businesses in energy, mobility, and manufacturing. Bengaluru electric mobility company Yulu serves as the first investment. The founding team includes industry veterans Mukund Rajan, Bobby Pauly, Mrinalini Mirchandani, and Sheetal Thakkar.
articles.description: The fund would focus on high-growth mid-market businesses across energy, mobility and manufacturing, with scale-up capital of ₹ 100–500 crore for enterprises with revenue between ₹200 and 2,000 crore, says One Planet Partners, an India-focused private equity firm

articles.headline: Sudan paramilitary commander Siddiq Ander defects from Rapid Support Forces
articles.title: RSF senior commander defects, accusing Sudan group’s leadership of nepotism
articles.summary: A senior commander of Sudan‘s Rapid Support Forces announced his departure in video footage published on Friday, accusing relatives of group leader Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo of tightly controlling finances and military promotions. The exit follows several high-profile defections this year amid an ongoing conflict between the army and the paramilitary group that has displaced millions.
articles.description: In exclusive footage obtained by Al Jazeera, Siddiq Ander describes RSF as a 'purely family-based project'.

articles.headline: Russian satellites assist Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia, investigation reveals
articles.title: Are Houthis using Russian satellites as Saudi Arabia fends off strikes?
articles.summary: An investigation by Geneva-based firm AURORAH Geosignal Intelligence revealed that Russian military and reconnaissance satellites observed targeted areas before and after forty attacks against Saudi Arabia. Three officials confirmed that the Iran-aligned Houthis have benefited from Russian intelligence alongside Chinese capabilities to target energy infrastructure.
articles.description: Analysts say the seizure of state arsenals, external backing and extensive military evolution has helped the Houthis.

articles.headline: Coastal Andhra Pradesh fisherfolk face financial crisis amid weather bans
articles.title: Coastal Andhra Pradesh fisherfolk face severe financial crisis amid Cyclones and frequent weather bans
articles.summary: Marine fishing communities in coastal Andhra Pradesh are facing severe financial distress due to frequent weather warnings and compulsory fishing bans issued by the India Meteorological Department. Cumulative losses have exceeded 36 crore rupees following multiple severe weather events, prompting fisherfolk organisations to petition Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu for enhanced financial compensation.
articles.description: Repeated bans across four major weather alerts since June have caused cumulative losses exceeding ₹36 crore

articles.headline: German companies view Hyderabad as base for innovation and research
articles.title: German companies looking at Hyderabad as base for innovation, research: Consul General Michael Hasper
articles.summary: German businesses are increasingly looking at Hyderabad as a hub for technology development due to the city's pharmaceutical ecosystem, engineering talent, and global capability centres. Speaking in Hyderabad on October 30, 2026, German Consul General Michael Hasper highlighted the mutual benefits of connecting Telangana's skilled workforce with opportunities in Germany.

articles.headline: Saudi air defences intercept hostile drone in Riyadh region
articles.title: Saudi Arabia says intercepted ‘hostile drone’ in Riyadh region
articles.summary: Military coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki stated that air defences destroyed an incoming drone on October 31, 2026. Debris fell without causing injuries, and the perpetrator remains unidentified. The incident occurs amid heightened regional hostilities involving Yemen's Houthis, who have recently increased attacks on Saudi infrastructure following the collapse of a 2022 truce over the summer.
articles.description: No information yet on who launched the drone

articles.headline: Prime Minister Modi praises ISRO scientists for successful satellite launch
articles.title: Launch of NVS-03: PM Modi congratulates scientists, engineers at ISRO
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated teams at the Indian Space Research Organisation following the October 31, 2026, launch of the GSLV-F18 rocket carrying the NVS-03 satellite. Officials noted the mission strengthens the indigenous NavIC navigation system and supports civilian applications like real-time tracking, advancing the nation toward technological self-reliance.
articles.description: Mr. Modi also said that equipped with enhanced capabilities, NVS-03 will further India’s pursuit of self-reliance in critical technologies and support navigation services that benefit the people

articles.headline: K.T. Rama Rao questions Union government over proposed IDBI Bank sale
articles.title: KTR questions proposed sale of IDBI Bank, asks if its valuable real estate assets were factored in valuation
articles.summary: Bharat Rashtra Samithi working president K.T. Rama Rao questioned the Union government's proposed sale of IDBI Bank to a private entity, raising concerns regarding valuation methods, bidding norm changes, and employee grievances. In a statement on October 31, 2026, the BRS leader asked whether prime real estate assets in Hyderabad were factored into the valuation and questioned the urgency behind the privatization of the public sector bank.
articles.description: BRS working president sought to know why the concerns raised by IDBI Bank employees over the proposed disinvestment were not being addressed

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Congress and VCK mobilise cadres for New Delhi protest
articles.title: Tamil Nadu Congress, VCK mobilise cadres for Nov. 1 INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi
articles.summary: Demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the Tamil Nadu Congress Committee and Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi have activated party networks to mobilise cadres for an INDIA bloc protest in New Delhi on November 1, 2026. According to Mayiladuthurai Member of Parliament R. Sudha, the Indian National Congress expects over five lakh participants, while alleging that the Bharatiya Janata Party-led Centre is curtailing parliamentary privileges.
articles.description: “We expect more than five lakh Congress cadres to participate. From Tamil Nadu, we are expecting at least 100 party workers to reach New Delhi from each district,” says MP R. Sudha

articles.headline: Authorities resume operations to recover chopper crash victims in Uttarakhand
articles.title: Operation underway to recover bodies from remote chopper crash site in Uttarakhand
articles.summary: Rescue operations resumed on October 31, 2026, to recover the bodies of six victims from a helicopter crash in Joshimath, Uttarakhand. The Trans Bharat Aviation private helicopter was returning from Badrinath when it crashed, killing the pilot and five pilgrims from Karnataka. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami stated that an investigation into the cause is underway by the Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau.
articles.description: A team from the forest department, Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau officials, a DGCA team have all been dispatched to the crash site
